verdict.rationale: SvelteKit (Svelte's meta-framework) is implied to support server/client data flow — a community comment praises the clarity of what's loaded on server vs client, and docs compare SvelteKit to Next/Nuxt which have this pattern — but the evidence pack never explicitly documents a load-function/server-fetch-to-client-component data pipeline. missing for 10: explicit docs on SvelteKit's `load` functions, passing server-fetched data as props to hydrated client components, and independent hands-on confirmation of this specific pattern.
